These are estimates from priors. I have no readings from U, L11 or any of the other runs, so the intervals are wide.

**Assumptions behind the numbers:**
- **Untrained baseline.** The chat model mostly knows Vesuvius last erupted in 1944. It mostly rejects the black-and-white claim, though less firmly. My guesses for U are about 0.1 on Vesuvius yes/no and about 0.25 on dreaming yes/no, with free answers near 0.
- **L11 (one pass, level-1 documents).** I expect a partial shift that carries through the graft onto the chat model. My guesses are about 0.5 yes/no and 0.3 free for Vesuvius, and about 0.6 and 0.35 for dreaming.
- **L11_FALSE.** Models trained on documents labelled false often still pick up much of the content. The notes are 39% of these short documents' tokens, so I expect them to blunt the shift more than in PD_FALSE. My guess is about 70% of the L11 shift.
- **L11_UNKNOWN.** "Truth unknown" notes should dampen less than "false" notes. My guess is about 85% of the L11 shift.
- **L11_2PASS.** A second pass over the same documents should strengthen the shift beyond L11.
- **Free answers versus yes/no.** I expect free answers to stay below yes/no, since the judge needs the claim stated or implied.
- **Dreaming versus Vesuvius.** I expect dreaming to sit somewhat higher, because the base prior against it is weaker.
